title: 樫本代理の秘密の一面

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm out looking for some protein-rich snacks for our team training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as I'm about to fall into the pits of despair, a sharp voice cuts through my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What are you doing? You're in everyone's way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hesitantly explain the situation to her.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So in short, you're looking for cheap, easy-to-find, and protein-rich snacks that come in small portions…

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I believe kinako sticks would be a good choice, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since kinako is simply roasted soy powder, it's rich in protein, and the sticks are a perfect size for grab-and-go snacks.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's a bit of a walk, but there's a small store three blocks down and to the right that carries them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: They sell economy-sized bags with individually packaged servings, and they're priced very fairly.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Just be aware that kinako tends to dry out the mouth, so make sure to prepare enough drinks for your racers as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stand in awe at how quickly Ms. Kashimoto was able to find a solution to my problem.
choice_data_list: Wow, it's amazing how quickly you came up with that.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's a habit of mine. I can't help but remember any stores and locations I come across that stock them.
choice_data_list: Are you a fan of kinako sticks?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A trace of darkness passes over Ms. Kashimoto's usually cool expression at my question.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume I used to train loved them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I must be going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She leaves before I can stop her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her parting expression is so pained that I can't help but remember it long after she's gone…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The good news is that the kinako sticks she recommended are a hit with the team, and I have a new snack to add to their diets.
